title: The wrong-room warning
subtitle: Wrong patient, right ward: the most common serious error, caught without a modal

steps.caption: Messages: every patient has a case room. Open Suresh Reddy's.
Type an order about a different patient into this room: "Give Rajesh Iyer 40mg prednisolone now."
Sent, not blocked. A nurse mid-emergency does not need a modal. Orb delivers it and says: this looks like it belongs to Rajesh Iyer, want me to move it?
